correctness.rationale: The original common-frame κ(B2^4,D4) requires one independent 4-frame and all 24 permutation-prefix simplices, each with its own enclosing ball. D4 consists of even-coordinate-sum integers; every squared norm is even. Any frame with max packet radius <sqrt(6)/2 would have all nonempty subset sums norm²<=4, forcing 4 independent vectors from the 48 D4 vectors of squared norm 2 or 4. Exact Gram-rank/backtracking enumeration of ALL ordered such prefix frames yields counts (1,48,816,1728,0), a legitimate exhaustive cutoff for all frames. A displayed determinant-2 D4 basis has for each permutation a midpoint ball through a diameter pair, 12 with radius²1 and 12 with radius²3/2. Thus κ=sqrt(3/2). Nearest integer rounding with an even-parity correction yields D4 covering radius at most1 and the integer vector (1,0,0,0) yields at least1. Independently ran exact integer recursion and verified every midpoint certificate and class count.
residual_risks: No classification of all minimizing frames; the relaxed periodic triangulation invariant has a different value and is not part of this claim.
